targetText: The "captivity" of women in the home, the way family interests are placed before all else, and the exercise of property rights by husband over wife are all being broken down by the basic principle of working-class ideology: comradely solidarity.
explanation: Comradely solidarity vs bourgeois family isolation: working-class ethics replace domestic subjugation and possessiveness with mutual respect and collective class unity.

targetText: Suppose family affairs require a businessman to take his capital out of a firm; bourgeois morality says "the interests of the family come first." Compare this with the attitude of workers to a strikebreaker who defies his comrades to earn wages for his family: working-class morality dictates "the interests of the class come first."
explanation: Class solidarity takes precedence over private family isolation: working-class liberation demands placing collective struggle above narrow individual domestic interests.

targetText: Only a code of sexual morality in harmony with the problems of the working class can serve as an important weapon in strengthening the working class's fighting position.
explanation: Proletarian ethics as an instrument of revolutionary struggle: creating healthy, comradely personal relations empowers the working class in its battle against capitalist exploitation.
